definitions.explanation: The formal or literary reading of 一昨日, used in written language, news, and formal speech. The everyday reading is おととい.

examples.japanese: {一昨日|いっさくじつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{議事録|ぎじろく}→議事録：07482_gijiroku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}した→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: I checked the minutes from the meeting the day before yesterday.

examples.japanese: {一昨日|いっさくじつ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{気温|きおん}→気温：00235_kion⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{急|きゅう}→急：13042_kyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{下|さ}がった→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧。
examples.english: The temperature dropped suddenly starting from the day before yesterday.

examples.japanese: {一昨日|いっさくじつ}{付|づ}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{新聞|しんぶん}→新聞：01440_shinbun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{関連|かんれん}→関連：00177_kanren⟧⟦{記事|きじ}→記事：00227_kiji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{掲載|けいさい}→掲載：08993_keisai⟧⟦されていた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A related article was published in the newspaper dated the day before yesterday.

notes:
いっさくじつ is the formal reading of {一昨日|おととい} (the day before yesterday). Both use the same kanji but differ in register.

READING CONTRAST:
- ⟦おととい→おととい：00877_ototoi⟧: everyday conversation, casual speech
- いっさくじつ: news broadcasts, official documents, formal writing, business contexts

COMMON PATTERNS:
The {一昨|いっさく}〜 prefix means "the ~ before last" and applies to other time words:
- {一昨日|いっさくじつ}: the day before yesterday
- ⟦{一昨年|いっさくねん}→一昨年：15474_issakunen⟧: the year before last
- ⟦{一昨晩|いっさくばん}→一昨晩：30391_issakuban⟧: the night before last

SIMILAR TIME WORDS:
- ⟦{昨日|きのう}→昨日：00859_kinou⟧/⟦{昨日|さくじつ}→昨日：27454_sakujitsu⟧: yesterday (casual/formal)
- {明後日|あさって}/⟦{明後日|みょうごにち}→明後日：00301_myougonichi⟧: the day after tomorrow (casual/formal)
